# Prime Fleet Care

> Prime Fleet Care is Perth, Western Australia's specialist mobile truck wash, fleet wash and fleet detailing service. We come to your depot, wash and detail on your fleet's schedule, offer bunded wastewater capture where your site needs it, and use eco-friendly products - keeping trucks road-ready with zero downtime and no wash bay required. Fully insured (public liability cover).

## Why fleet operators choose Prime Fleet Care
- Fully mobile - we bring power, pressure washers and all equipment to your yard and use your site's water supply (or bring our own if needed, charged on the invoice). You never move a truck or need a wash bay.
- Works around your fleet's schedule - early-morning starts, late-night finishes and weekends, so washing never disrupts your runs.
- Wastewater capture available - where your site needs runoff contained, we bund the wash zone, capture all washwater and dispose of it responsibly off site, itemised on the invoice. No stormwater runoff, no environmental compliance risk for your depot.
- Eco-friendly products - biodegradable cleaning chemicals that are tough on diesel soot, grease and road grime but safe for the environment.
- Fully insured - public liability cover on every job.
- Reliable and consistent - operators consistently rate us 5/5 for showing up on time and delivering clean trucks every single visit.

## Services (mobile truck wash and fleet detailing, on-site)
Core services:
- Fleet wash: full exterior wash of cab, body, wheels and trailer
- Full detailing (premium): inside and out (exterior paint correction and protection plus deep cab clean) - the best-value option; exterior-only and interior-only details also available. Details: https://primefleetcare.com.au/truck-detailing.html
- Aluminium polishing (premium): bullbars, fuel tanks, wheels, grilles, stacks, toolboxes and trims, polished on site. Details: https://primefleetcare.com.au/aluminium-polishing.html

Add-ons (with any wash or detail):
- Engine and radiator degreasing
- Underbody / undercarriage cleaning
- Interior cab wipe and vacuum
- Trailer interior wash
- Ceramic sealant for long-term paint protection
- Wastewater capture and disposal (bunded wash zone; charged on the invoice)
- Recurring weekly, fortnightly and monthly fleet wash and detailing programs (fleet pricing for 10+ vehicles)

## Vehicles serviced
Semi-trailers, prime movers, rigid trucks, tippers, tankers, refrigerated vans, utes and light commercial vehicles - single trucks through to entire fleets.

## Service area
Perth metropolitan area - including Fremantle, Kwinana, Rockingham, Mandurah, Joondalup, Midland, Malaga, Welshpool, Kewdale, Forrestfield, Kenwick, Canning Vale, Osborne Park and Wangara - plus regional WA (Kalgoorlie, Bunbury, Geraldton) on request.
